r4.why: Named for Gilbert Walker (16), Bjerknes 1969 east-west loop (17), arid zone and ITCZ cloud bands (18), Hadley edges (19).

r5.why: 1904 Cambridge mathematician to India (22), monsoon and 1899 famine (23), fifteen-year seesaw work (24), sunspots rejected (34), published all correlations and why (35-36).
